focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：关键矿产出口管制博弈升级，绿色补贴与关税工具并行
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸主线围绕关键矿产与绿色产业展开。印尼、智利等资源国加快镍、锂等矿产的出口限制与本地加工要求，欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期核查趋严，美国则继续以关税与补贴组合推动供应链本土化。与此同时，多国在WTO框架下就矿产出口限制提出磋商请求，规则博弈升温。趋势上，资源民族主义与气候贸易措施叠加，中国出海企业面临原材料成本与合规双重压力，需提前布局多元化供应与本地化生产。
focus.source: 来源：综合WTO、欧盟委员会、美国贸易代表办公室等公开信息 · 本周
focus.title_en: This Week's Global Trade Mainline: Critical Minerals Export Control Contest Escalates, Green Subsidies and Tariff Tools Advance in Parallel
focus.summary_en: This week's international trade mainline centered on critical minerals and green industries. Resource-rich countries such as Indonesia and Chile accelerated export restrictions and local processing requirements for nickel and lithium; the EU tightened verification during the CBAM transitional period; and the US continued to combine tariffs and subsidies to localize supply chains. Meanwhile, several countries filed WTO consultation requests over mineral export restrictions, intensifying rule-based competition. The trend shows resource nationalism overlapping with climate trade measures, putting dual pressure on Chinese outbound enterprises regarding raw material costs and compliance, requiring early diversification of supply and localized production.
focus.source_en: Source: Compiled from public information of WTO, European Commission, USTR, etc. · this week

case.title: 本周案例：新加坡仲裁庭认可中国法院保全裁定，跨境仲裁临时措施协作现积极信号
case.summary: 本周，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）公布一起涉及中国企业的海事货物运输合同仲裁案。仲裁庭依据《新加坡国际仲裁法》及SIAC规则，认可了中国某海事法院此前作出的财产保全裁定，并据此发布临时措施令，冻结被申请人在新加坡的银行账户。该案凸显《新加坡调解公约》与双边司法协助安排下，跨境仲裁临时措施的可执行性增强。启示：出海企业应在合同中明确仲裁地与保全协作条款，并在争议初期同步启动多地保全，防止资产转移。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）案例摘要 · 本周
case.title_en: Case of the Week: Singapore Arbitral Tribunal Recognizes Chinese Court Preservation Ruling, Positive Signal for Cross-Border Interim Measures Cooperation
case.summary_en: This week, the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) published an arbitration case concerning a Chinese enterprise in a maritime cargo transport contract. The tribunal, pursuant to the Singapore International Arbitration Act and SIAC Rules, recognized a property preservation ruling previously issued by a Chinese maritime court and accordingly issued an interim measures order freezing the respondent's bank account in Singapore. The case highlights enhanced enforceability of cross-border interim measures under the Singapore Convention on Mediation and bilateral judicial assistance arrangements. Takeaway: outbound enterprises should specify arbitration seats and preservation cooperation clauses in contracts, and simultaneously initiate multi-jurisdictional preservation at the early stage of disputes to prevent asset dissipation.
case.source_en: Source: SIAC case summary · this week

policy.title: 本周政策：粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动与职业资格互认再提速，涉外法治服务迎利好
policy.summary: 本周，粤港澳大湾区在跨境数据流动与职业资格互认方面取得新进展。广东省相关部门发布指引，进一步扩大粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动试点范围，允许金融、医疗、商贸等领域企业在安全评估下开展数据跨境传输。同时，粤港澳三地就律师、会计师等专业资格互认展开新一轮磋商，前海、横琴等合作区推出涉外法律服务集聚措施。此外，内地与香港就民商事判决互认安排的实施细则进一步明确。趋势：大湾区制度型开放加速，为出海企业提供更便利的跨境合规与争议解决支持。
policy.source: 来源：广东省人民政府、香港律政司、澳门法务局等公开信息 · 本周
policy.title_en: Policy of the Week: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow and Professional Qualification Mutual Recognition Accelerate, Favorable for Foreign-Related Legal Services
policy.summary_en: This week, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area made new progress in cross-border data flow and mutual recognition of professional qualifications. Relevant Guangdong authorities issued guidelines to further expand the pilot scope of cross-border data flow in the Greater Bay Area, allowing enterprises in finance, healthcare, and trade to conduct cross-border data transfers under security assessments. Meanwhile, the three jurisdictions held a new round of consultations on mutual recognition of professional qualifications for lawyers and accountants, and cooperation zones such as Qianhai and Hengqin introduced measures to cluster foreign-related legal services. In addition, implementation details of the mutual recognition arrangement for civil and commercial judgments between the Mainland and Hong Kong were further clarified. Trend: institutional opening in the Greater Bay Area is accelerating, providing more convenient cross-border compliance and dispute resolution support for outbound enterprises.
policy.source_en: Source: Public information from Guangdong Provincial People's Government, Hong Kong Department of Justice, Macao Legal Affairs Bureau, etc. · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：供应链合规从成本项转为竞争力，下周关注矿产出口管制与CBAM细则
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周趋势表明，全球供应链合规已从成本项转变为企业竞争力。资源国出口限制与气候贸易措施叠加，要求出海企业将法律合规前置到投资决策阶段。建议：一、对关键矿产依赖度高的企业，尽快建立多元化供应与本地加工布局；二、在合同中加入出口管制与制裁变化时的重新谈判条款；三、利用大湾区跨境数据与资格互认政策，优化跨境争议解决架构。下周重点关注：印尼镍出口政策落地、欧盟CBAM过渡期核查指引、以及美国对华关税复审进展。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队 · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: Supply chain compliance shifts from cost item to competitiveness; watch mineral export controls and CBAM details next week
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's trends indicate that global supply chain compliance has shifted from a cost item to a competitiveness factor. The overlap of resource-country export restrictions and climate trade measures requires outbound enterprises to front-load legal compliance into investment decisions. Recommendations: First, enterprises highly dependent on critical minerals should promptly establish diversified supply and local processing arrangements; second, include renegotiation clauses in contracts for changes in export controls and sanctions; third, leverage Greater Bay Area cross-border data and qualification mutual recognition policies to optimize cross-border dispute resolution structures. Key focuses next week: implementation of Indonesia's nickel export policy, EU CBAM transitional verification guidelines, and progress of the US tariff review on China.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao's team · this week
